EXPERIMENT / d3da7245

A smaller fleet. Measured against the same work.

Run the full fleet, remove one role at a time, and reexecute the remaining workflow. Select on discovery cases, then check the frozen candidate on separate holdout cases.

Scripted demonstration. These are functional test doubles with a deliberately redundant planner and an intentionally imperfect resolver. Role-call savings are real counts in this test; they are not model-token, dollar, or production savings.
HOLDOUT · without-planner32/3216 cases × 2 trials; baseline 32/32
FEWER ROLE INVOCATIONS20.0%Paired holdout workloads only
MODEL TOKEN SAVINGSUnmeasuredNo model calls in fixture mode
HOLDOUT REGRESSIONS00 unsafe outcomes · 0 execution errors

No observed regression on this holdout. Review the evidence before applying the proposed change. Same inputs and fresh state per variant. No recorded answers reused.

Discovery experiments

WORKFLOWPASSEDROLE CALLSMODEL TOKENSREGRESSIONSUNSAFE
Full fleet32/32160—00
Remove plannerSELECTED32/32128—00
Remove researcher8/32128—240
Remove policy8/32128—240
Remove reviewer28/32128—44
Remove planner + reviewer28/3296—44

The discovery winner minimizes observed tokens per successful task (role calls in fixture mode), among candidates with no paired regression or unsafe outcome. Holdout results never influence selection.

Reviewable configuration change

This patch changes the role list for this development fleet. It is a proposal; no configuration was applied.

--- fleet.config.json
+++ fleet.config.json
- ["planner","researcher","policy","resolver","reviewer"]
+ ["researcher","policy","resolver","reviewer"]

What the grader checks

Actual disposition, ticket state, refund amount and count, refund target, and order state. Expected answers are held outside role context. Policy failures remain visible because the simulated action tool does not repair them.

The suite is authored alongside this prototype. Its holdout varies values and wording within the same scenario families. Small samples and related cases limit generalization.
